neighbours.label: ' of' after a predicate noun that names what the preceding subject is ('X was the main focus of', 'that is the conclusion of'): the subject comes first and the noun identifies it
fire: Why honeybees abandon healthy hives was the central question of the three-year project.
Cheap housing for young families will be the theme of this year's conference.
Fewer cars, cleaner air has been the slogan of the mayor's campaign.
Regular walking lowers blood pressure. That is the main result of a large Danish trial.
How glaciers carve valleys is the subject of the first chapter.
Saving the old theatre from demolition was the aim of the petition.
Teaching refugees to code is the mission of a small charity in Leeds.
Whether the bridge can carry heavy trucks was the key issue of last night's meeting.
quiet: The central question of the three-year project was why honeybees abandon healthy hives.
The theme of this year's conference will be cheap housing for young families.
The slogan of the mayor's campaign has been fewer cars, cleaner air.
Regular walking lowers blood pressure. A large Danish trial measured thousands of adults.
The first chapter explains how glaciers carve valleys over thousands of years.
The petition gathered two thousand signatures to save the old theatre from demolition.
A small charity in Leeds teaches refugees to code on donated laptops.
Last night's meeting lasted three hours and ended without a vote on the bridge.

notes: Card: ' of' / ' in' / ' for' / ' as' after 'is the focus', 'is the topic', 'was the motto', 'is the finding', 'le point de départ de'. Probes: subject-first copular order 0.37-0.88; the same nouns in subject position ('The focus of this study was ...') 0.13; no such noun 0.02. Near misses put the same noun + ' of' in subject position or drop the identifying noun.
